panel.name: panel_performance_autoadjustments

spinner.name: target_fps
spinner.tool_tip: The viewer will attempt to achieve this by adjusting your graphics settings.

panel.text: Your display supports up to [FPS_LIMIT] fps.

button.name: start_autotune
button.label: Auto-adjust now
button.tool_tip: The viewer will attempt to adjust settings to meet the target FPS then stop.

check_box.name: AutoTuneContinuous
check_box.label: Adjust continuously
check_box.tool_tip: The viewer will continually adapt the settings to meet the target FPS until stopped even with the floater closed.

check_box.name: vsync
check_box.label: Enable VSync
check_box.tool_tip: Enable Vertical synchronization to reduce screen tearing and stuttering.

panel.text: Matches monitor refresh rate with frame rate.
Note: Turning on VSync limits frame rate to [FPS_LIMIT] fps.
Reducing detail shown on avatars that are far away will improve graphics speed.

check_box.name: AutoTuneImpostorByDistEnabled
check_box.label: Simplify avatars beyond
check_box.tool_tip: When enabled the viewer will adjust the MaxNonImpostors setting to limit fully rendered avatars to those within the defined radius.

panel.text: Choose the distance range that automatic settings will affect.
